ck_attachment_target.name: ck_attachment_target
ck_attachment_target.value:
(
    ("app"."attachment"."status" = 'temp' AND "app"."attachment"."target_type" IS NULL AND "app"."attachment"."target_id" IS NULL
      AND "app"."attachment"."bound_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("app"."attachment"."status" in ('bound', 'removed') AND "app"."attachment"."target_type" in ('requirement', 'bug')
      AND "app"."attachment"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."attachment"."bound_at" IS NOT NULL)
  )

ck_bug_reproduction.name: ck_bug_reproduction
ck_bug_reproduction.value: ("app"."bug"."reproduction_unknown" = true) OR ("app"."bug"."reproduction" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."bug"."reproduction")) > 0)

ck_change_plan_deploy_target.name: ck_change_plan_deploy_target
ck_change_plan_deploy_target.value: ("app"."change_plan"."operation_kind" = 'deploy_version' and "app"."change_plan"."service_id" is not null and "app"."change_plan"."workflow_path" is not null) or ("app"."change_plan"."operation_kind" <> 'deploy_version' and "app"."change_plan"."service_id" is null)

ck_project_env_var_ref.name: ck_project_env_var_ref
ck_project_env_var_ref.value: ("app"."project_env_var"."kind" = 'credential_ref' and "app"."project_env_var"."credential_id" is not null and "app"."project_env_var"."value_text" is null) or ("app"."project_env_var"."kind" = 'plain' and "app"."project_env_var"."credential_id" is null and "app"."project_env_var"."value_text" is not null)

ck_requirement_content_fields.name: ck_requirement_content_fields
ck_requirement_content_fields.value:
(
    ("app"."requirement"."content_mode" = 'markdown' AND "app"."requirement"."content_markdown" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."requirement"."content_markdown")) > 0)
    OR ("app"."requirement"."content_mode" = 'external_link' AND "app"."requirement"."external_url" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."requirement"."external_url")) > 0)
  )

ck_storage_bucket_s3_fields.name: ck_storage_bucket_s3_fields
ck_storage_bucket_s3_fields.value:
(
    ("app"."storage_bucket"."kind" = 's3' AND "app"."storage_bucket"."endpoint" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."bucket_name" IS NOT NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."region" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_iv" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_auth_tag" IS NOT NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_key_version" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."is_builtin" = false)
    OR ("app"."storage_bucket"."kind" = 'local' AND "app"."storage_bucket"."is_builtin" = true AND "app"."storage_bucket"."endpoint" IS NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."bucket_name" IS NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."region" IS NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."path_prefix" IS NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."access_key_hint" IS NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_iv" IS NULL AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_auth_tag" IS NULL
      AND "app"."storage_bucket"."credential_key_version" IS NULL)
  )
